items.text:
The idea is amazing.
Control and gameplay atrocious.
User interface is lored, themed and also atrocious.
Ship status is just text report, building ships pieces from memory, and mostly trial and error.
Again, amazing idea, but I bought this whitout watching a gameplay, thats the reason, its my problem, I wouldnt buy it otherwise.
I will not return, just and advice, check gameplay video before buy.
items.text_zh:
这个想法很棒。
操控和玩法糟透了。
用户界面有背景设定、有主题，但也糟透了。
飞船状态只是文字报告，凭记忆拼装飞船部件，而且大多是试错。
再说一次，想法很棒，但我买之前没看实机演示，这就是原因，这是我的问题，否则我不会买。
我不会退款，只是给个建议，买之前看看实机演示视频。
